facts.text: DAQ_1DViewer_Omnidriver is the PyMoDAQ viewer plugin that controls Ocean Insight spectrometers through the OmniDriver NETWrapper
The plugin discovers every connected spectrometer with NETWrapper.openAllSpectrometers, reads its name with getName and keeps the names and ids of the discovered devices
get_xaxis(ind_spectro) reads the calibrated wavelengths from controller.getWavelengths and returns them as an array
The millisecond exposure setting is multiplied by 1000 before setIntegrationTime and divided by 1000 after getIntegrationTime, so the controller integration time is in microseconds
The plugin reads getMaximumIntegrationTime and getMinimumIntegrationTime for every discovered spectrometer at initialization
The exposure-time parameter bounds are the device values divided by 1000 and cast to int, so they are read from the device at runtime
The plugin keeps each spectrometer's exposure_time child in self.settings, the Parameter tree of its base class, and commit_settings reads the changed parameter back
grab_data sets the hardware averaging with setScansToAverage, reads the spectrum with getSpectrum and emits it in a DataToExport
The emitted wavelength axis is the get_xaxis vector in nanometres multiplied by 1e-9, and the axis is labelled in metres
stop calls controller.stopAveraging for every discovered spectrometer
The OmniDriver wrapper is imported through pythonnet/clr only when omnidriver_path is configured; otherwise the module global omnidriver stays None
